speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal imaging and recent sinusitis, could you describe any new skin rashes, joint pain, or recent tick bites, as these are concerning for post-streptococcal or viral triggers like IgA nephropathy? Also, have you noticed any visible blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (atypical presentation or early treatment failure). Given the persistent fever, flank pain, and fatigue despite recent antibiotic therapy for sinusitis, this suggests a secondary urinary tract infection or that the initial antibiotics were ineffective against the uropathogen. The normal imaging rules out obstruction or abscess, pointing toward acute parenchymal infection. I will confirm this with the pending culture results and urine analysis.
